school_name: State University of New York at Cortland
title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain State University of New York at Cortland
description: Ten currently listed, under-21-safe Cortland destinations with evening availability. Check the source before leaving, as hours can change.

cards.title: Kalash Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 54 Main St, Cortland
cards.notes: Use the posted daily midnight closing time for a late Main Street food stop; confirm availability or ordering details directly before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Main Street restaurant with daily hours listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalash Kitchen lists Cortland hours ending at 12 a.m. every day and gives its address as 54 Main St.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Wednesday 10 a.m.–12 a.m. and Thursday–Sunday 11 a.m.–12 a.m.

cards.title: BRIX
cards.subtitle: 60 Main St, Cortland
cards.notes: On Friday or Saturday, plan around the posted 11 p.m. close and use BRIX’s official site for current menu, takeout, or reservation information.
cards.short_summary: Main Street restaurant with Friday–Saturday hours to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: BRIX lists its address as 60 Main St and Friday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11 p.m.; other listed days close at 9 p.m.

cards.title: Pontillo's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 124 Groton Ave, Cortland
cards.notes: For a late pickup or delivery plan, use the restaurant’s official ordering link and allow for the posted ready-time estimates before closing.
cards.short_summary: Pizza restaurant listing daily service until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pontillo's official site lists 124 Groton Ave and says it is open daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site states “OPEN DAILY 11 AM -10 PM” and provides pickup and delivery ordering.

cards.title: Pudgie's Pizza Cortland
cards.subtitle: 75 N Main St, Cortland
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday option when the official listing extends to 10 p.m.; verify whether delivery is still accepting orders.
cards.short_summary: North Main pizza shop with Friday–Saturday service to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pudgie's Pizza Cortland lists Friday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and delivery until 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Sunday–Thursday until 9 p.m. and Friday–Saturday, including delivery, until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Arctic Bites
cards.subtitle: 178 Clinton Ave, Cortland
cards.notes: Use the Friday–Saturday 11 p.m. closing window for an evening dessert or food stop, then check the official page for any update.
cards.short_summary: Clinton Avenue restaurant with Friday–Saturday hours to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Arctic Bites lists 178 Clinton Ave and Friday–Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Monday–Thursday until 10 p.m., Friday–Saturday until 11 p.m., and Sunday until 10 p.m.

cards.title: KFC on State Route 281
cards.subtitle: 3890 State Route 281, Cortland
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s location page to confirm drive-thru or dining details, with posted daily restaurant hours extending through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Route 281 quick-service restaurant listed open to 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC's official Cortland location page lists 3890 State Route 281 and 10 a.m.–11 p.m. hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Moe's Southwest Grill
cards.subtitle: 872 Route 13, Cortland
cards.notes: For an evening Route 13 food stop, check the official location page and place an order before its listed 10 p.m. daily close.
cards.short_summary: Route 13 restaurant with daily hours listed through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Moe's official Cortland location page lists 872 Route 13 and hours of 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Denny's on River Street
cards.subtitle: 1 River St, Cortland
cards.notes: Schedule this option for Friday or Saturday, when the official location page lists 10 p.m. closing; check that day’s listing before travel.
cards.short_summary: River Street diner with Friday–Saturday hours listed to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official Cortland location page lists Friday and Saturday restaurant hours from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Saturday until 10 p.m.; Monday–Thursday and Sunday until 9 p.m.

cards.title: 281 Bowl
cards.subtitle: 3898 State Route 281, Cortland
cards.notes: For a non-dining evening outing, call before leaving because open-bowling availability can change with leagues, parties, and tournaments.
cards.short_summary: Bowling destination listing Friday and Saturday operation until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: 281 Bowl lists Friday and Saturday hours until 12 a.m. and advises visitors to call ahead for open-bowling availability.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday 3 p.m.–12 a.m. and Saturday 1 p.m.–12 a.m.; it says hours and lanes can vary, so call ahead.

cards.title: SUNY Cortland Dining Services
cards.subtitle: SUNY Cortland campus
cards.notes: Consult the Auxiliary Services hours page before going; it states campus residential and retail dining options can run as late as 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining system with stated operating range up to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland Auxiliary Services states its campus residential and retail dining options have hours ranging from 7:30 a.m. to 11 p.m., seven days a week.
cards.source_title: SUNY Cortland Auxiliary Services Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Official dining page states hours range from 7:30 a.m. to 11 p.m., seven days a week; consult its hours-of-operation link for venue-specific service.
